# Chemical Bull

> > Chemical Bull Pvt Ltd supplies pharmaceutical chemicals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and specialty compounds for respiratory, cardiovascular, neurological, and oncological applications.

Chemical Bull Pvt Ltd is a manufacturer and supplier specializing in pharmaceutical-grade chemicals including corticosteroids, beta-agonists, antidepressants, chemotherapy agents, and pharmaceutical intermediates. The company serves the pharmaceutical industry with APIs, impurity standards, and specialty compounds for drug formulation and quality control.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical APIs
- Corticosteroids (ICS)
- Respiratory medications
- Guaifenesin
- Dextromethorphan
- Beta-blockers
- SNRIs (Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors)
- Neurotransmitters (serotonin, norepinephrine, dopamine)
- API impurities and quality control
- Pharmaceutical intermediates
- Alkylating agents
- Dehydrating agents
- Anti-inflammatory compounds
- Chemotherapy agents

## Pharmaceutical APIs & Quality Control

- [Api Impurities](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/api-impurities): Pharmaceutical API impurity control for quality and FDA compliance
- [Synthetic Corticosteroids](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/synthetic-corticosteroids): Anti-inflammatory steroids: hydrocortisone, betamethasone, dexamethasone
- [Alkylating Agents](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/alkylating-agents): Chemotherapy agents: nitrogen mustards, platinum drugs for cancer treatment

## Respiratory & Pulmonary Medications

- [Expectorants](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/expectorants): Mucus clearance agents featuring Guaifenesin for respiratory relief
- [Antitussive Agents](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/antitussive-agents): Cough suppressants: Dextromethorphan, Codeine, Guaifenesin products
- [Long-acting Beta Agonists](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/long-acting-beta-agonists): LABAs for sustained bronchodilation in asthma and COPD treatment
- [Antileukotriene](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/antileukotriene): Leukotriene inhibitors for asthma and allergy inflammation management

## Cardiovascular Medications

- [Beta Blockers](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/beta-blockers): Cardiovascular beta-adrenergic receptor blocking agents for hypertension
- [Antihypertensive Vasodilator Drugs](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/antihypertensive-vasodilator-drugs): Blood pressure vasodilators: hydralazine, minoxidil, nitroprusside

## Neurological & Psychiatric Medications

- [Snris](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/snris): Serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors for depression and anxiety
- [Mao Inhibitors](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/mao-inhibitors): Monoamine oxidase inhibitors regulating neurotransmitter levels
- [Decarboxylase Inhibitors](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/decarboxylase-inhibitors): Carbidopa and enzyme inhibitors for Parkinson's disease treatment

## Pharmaceutical Intermediates & Salts

- [Mesylates](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/mesylates): Methanesulfonate pharmaceutical intermediates for organic synthesis
- [Succinate](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/succinate): Succinic acid esters including Cetilistat and Trelagliptin Succinate
- [Bitartrates](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/bitartrates): Tartaric acid salts and cream of tartar for food and pharma use
- [Butyrates](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/butyrates): Short-chain fatty acids for gut health and immune regulation support

## Specialty Pharmaceutical Compounds

- [Aceponates](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/aceponates): Steroidal anti-inflammatory aceponates for pharmaceutical applications
- [Hydroxypropyl Compounds](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/hydroxypropyl-compounds): HPC and HPMC cellulose derivatives for pharmaceutical excipients
- [Monomethyl Compounds](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/monomethyl-compounds): Methylamine and dimethyl ether for industrial chemistry applications

## Industrial & Laboratory Chemicals

- [Dehydrating Agents](https://www.chemicalbull.com/chemicals/dehydrating-agents): Desiccants & dehydrators: sulfuric acid, calcium chloride, silica gel
